brief: ON_PLAIN single-panel CameraX probe for one narrow question: does the emulator expose a working back-camera HAL to an ordinary Android activity? The hand-authored panel fills its black window with PreviewView, reports IDLE or STREAMING, and displays full CameraX failures.
honesty: The AppSpec below is a corpus-compatible descriptive shape only. The Spatial AppSpec compiler emits a generic HUD and does NOT generate CameraX, PreviewView, or this probe. Build the classic Android implementation at execution.projectPath. That path is a local-machine project, not source committed in this repository. A successful compile proves structure only; only a human/vision-capable agent looking at a launch capture can decide whether a camera feed is visible.

structural: assembleDebug succeeds and produces an APK for com.pico.camerapeek
the manifest declares android.permission.CAMERA and a required back-camera feature
a fresh install requests CAMERA at runtime before attempting to bind
the launcher is a resizeable, hardware-accelerated, landscape, singleTask activity with its own panel taskAffinity
CameraX 1.5.3 camera-camera2, camera-lifecycle, and camera-view are resolved
the activity binds DEFAULT_BACK_CAMERA through ProcessCameraProvider and logs/displays previewStreamState
